title: First-impression capacity glance and autoscale vignettes
creator: Maya Singh
description: Design a compact, first-impression set of onboarding visuals that communicate: (1) a Quick Capacity Glance (estimated throughput, recommended GPU pool size, cost tier), (2) Autoscale Vignettes (behavior under burst, cooldown, and fallback), and (3) a concise SLA Snapshot Card (uptime, latency SLO, fallback policy). Deliver hi-fi screens, responsive breakpoints (desktop/tablet/mobile), export-ready assets for the Console release, and microcopy that fits 1–2 lines per card. Include an accessibility checklist and export tokens for dev handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct UI canvases delivered: Capacity Glance, Autoscale Vignettes, SLA Snapshot
Microcopy reviewed and signed off by PM (tone: clear, non-technical, action-oriented)
Assets exported as SVG + PNG (1x/2x) and a tokens.json for colors/spacing/typography
Figma file annotated with copy variants and interactive prototype for dev handoff
Design accessibility checklist completed (contrast, focus order, alt text)
tasks: Wireframe three canvas states and get PM alignment
Create hi-fi components and variants in Figma (light/dark)
Write final microcopy and annotate truncation rules
Prepare export tokens and assets; run basic accessibility checks
Produce a short dev handoff doc and upload assets to Drive
Record a 5-minute walkthrough video for design handoff
